routines.name: insert_calculation_validation
routines.arguments: p_settlement_id text, p_energy_contract_id text, p_organization_id text, p_is_valid boolean, p_errors jsonb, p_warnings jsonb, p_consumption_kwh numeric, p_regulated_cost numeric, p_acl_cost numeric, p_gross_savings numeric, p_net_savings numeric, p_honorarie numeric, p_total_cost numeric, p_final_value numeric, p_validated_by text, p_metadata jsonb, p_validated_at timestamp with time zone
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.insert_calculation_validation(p_settlement_id text, p_energy_contract_id text, p_organization_id text, p_is_valid boolean, p_errors jsonb, p_warnings jsonb, p_consumption_kwh numeric, p_regulated_cost numeric, p_acl_cost numeric, p_gross_savings numeric, p_net_savings numeric, p_honorarie numeric, p_total_cost numeric, p_final_value numeric, p_validated_by text, p_metadata jsonb, p_validated_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Apenas inserir (sem validação, já validado no NestJS)
  INSERT INTO public.calculation_validations (
    settlement_id,
    energy_contract_id,
    organization_id,
    is_valid,
    errors,
    warnings,
    consumption_kwh,
    regulated_cost,
    acl_cost,
    gross_savings,
    net_savings,
    honorarie,
    total_cost,
    final_value,
    validated_by,
    metadata,
    validated_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_settlement_id,
    p_energy_contract_id,
    p_organization_id,
    p_is_valid,
    p_errors,
    p_warnings,
    p_consumption_kwh,
    p_regulated_cost,
    p_acl_cost,
    p_gross_savings,
    p_net_savings,
    p_honorarie,
    p_total_cost,
    p_final_value,
    p_validated_by,
    p_metadata,
    p_validated_at
  );

  RETURN TRUE;
END;

$function$

view:
SELECT ec.id,
    ec.contract_number,
    cust.company_name,
    cu.consumer_unit_number,
    ec.end_date,
    EXTRACT(day FROM ec.end_date::timestamp with time zone - now()) AS days_to_expiration
   FROM energy_contracts ec
     JOIN customers cust ON ec.customer_id = cust.id
     JOIN consumer_units cu ON ec.consumer_unit_id = cu.id
  WHERE ec.status::text = 'ACTIVE'::text AND ec.end_date <= (now() + '90 days'::interval) AND ec.end_date > now()
  ORDER BY ec.end_date;
